subject.title: [Feature]: Per-bot context isolation in multi-bot Feishu groups - only record context when mentioned

question: Should Feishu add an explicit per-bot context policy, reinterpret requireMention to suppress skipped-message history, or keep the current shared group-history behavior?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent fix adds public Feishu config and changes what group messages enter model context, which is a product and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add Explicit Context Policy
options.body: Introduce a Feishu plugin-owned context policy such as mention-only/per-bot history with current behavior preserved as the default and documented upgrade behavior.

options.title: Redefine requireMention History
options.body: Make requireMention also suppress unmentioned history recording, accepting the compatibility change for existing Feishu group users.

options.title: Keep Shared History
options.body: Document the shared group-history behavior as intentional and route finer target attribution to the broader group-context work.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Context Policy
recommendation.body: Introduce a Feishu plugin-owned context policy such as mention-only/per-bot history with current behavior preserved as the default and documented upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already tied to the related Feishu multi-bot identity review surface and can route the compatibility/security decision to Feishu owners.
